messages:
charlie: us-east2 NVMe IOPS spiked to ~210k for 12m, several GPU attach timeouts. infra-bot alerted.
infra-bot: [ALERT] nvme_iops > 200000 (us-east2) - 12m. dash: /dash/region/us-east2/iops. runbook: /runbooks/attach-pressure.md
meera: pattern shows janitor deep-scrub + many concurrent image pulls. pending GPU pods ~60.
jon: scrub_concurrency was bumped to 12 in last week's cleanup. that likely pushed controllers over the queue limit. recommend immediate region-scoped throttle.
rachel: agree. quick hotfix: reduce SCRUB_CONCURRENCY and scale cleaner down. commands (us-east2 namespace):
```
kubectl set env deployment/cleaner CLEANER_SCRUB_CONCURRENCY=4 -n infra-us-east2
kubectl set env deployment/cleaner ENABLE_AGGRESSIVE_TRIM=false -n infra-us-east2
kubectl scale deployment/cleaner --replicas=1 -n infra-us-east2
```
charlie: apply and monitor. if not healthy in 20m, spill 10% of new GPU allocations to eu-west1 for 2h as fallback. cost estimated ~+$100/hr.
meera: patching now. will also flip local-image-cache to warm for 45m to reduce read amplification.
infra-bot: [ACTION] cleaner env patched by meera (CLEANER_SCRUB_CONCURRENCY=4).
jon: immediate effect: iops 210k -> 65k in ~7m, pending GPUs down 60 -> 8. attach latencies back to normal.
rachel: leaving throttles for 45m and filing RFC for adaptive-scrub and region-scoped concurrency knobs.
charlie: schedule retro with janitor/scheduler/infra tomorrow 09:30. closing unless we see regressions. :thumbsup:
